indicator_assessments.name: DRAM Price Evolution (spot + contract matrix)
indicator_assessments.description: 5x5 trigger matrix mapping DRAM contract QoQ growth (rows) against DDR5 16Gb 4800/5600 spot drawdown from rolling 12-week peak (cols). Returns Not fired / Partially fired / Fired per cell. Replaces the v3.39 absolute-threshold trigger ($38.2 spot / $950 module). The matrix is the framework's canonical early-warning signal — spot drawdown leads contract direction by 6-10 weeks. Matrix engine: src/data/cycle_matrix.py; charts: src/analysis/chart_generator.py.
indicator_assessments.what_to_look_for: Today's cell position on the 5x5 matrix. ROWS (contract QoQ): R1 >=+30%, R2 +20-30%, R3 +10-20%, R4 +5-10%, R5 <=+5%. COLS (spot drawdown from rolling 12w peak): C1 at peak, C2 <5% off, C3 5-10% off, C4 10-20% off, C5 >=20% off. Not fired = R1/R2 with low drawdown (full position). Partially fired = mid-band (review thesis, consider 25-33% trim). Fired = any R4-R5 row, any C5 column, or R3+C4. Historical cycle peaks all landed in R5 by the time contract growth hit ~0% — the matrix exists to act BEFORE that. Contract row uses a SYNTHETIC estimate: anchor (most recent TrendForce quarterly forecast, preferring server_ddr5 > conventional_dram_aggregate segments) + 0.4 * tone_adj + 0.4 * supplier_adj + 0.2 * spot_lead_adj, each capped +/-30pp.

This is the 'infrastructure is built' moment: a peak-confirmation signal, distinct from CapEx acceleration (t2_capex_parabolic, boom fuel) and from CapEx cuts (Tier 4, bust confirmation).
indicator_assessments.what_to_look_for: SCORING MODEL (v3.45.0, deterministic via the guidance ledger): per company (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META), latest print vs that company's OWN PRIOR FORWARD GUIDANCE — the signal is the SURPRISE, not the level. Points: RAISE >5% above prior guidance = -1 (accelerating). REITERATE/CONFIRM within ±5% = +1 (stable — merely confirming the number IS the event). CUT >5% = +2 (BEYOND plateau — 'we are done'). Withheld forward guidance after previously guiding = 0 points + watch flag (does NOT count toward the plateau tally). No print this cycle = 0, 'awaiting print'. STATUS IS DECIDED BY COUNT ALONE (ruling 2026-08-08): N = companies at stable-or-cutting: 0 = Not fired; 1-2 = Partially fired; 3-4 = Fired. Raises can never veto the count floor; cuts can never jump the band — the score S is INTENSITY display only. HARD RULE — qualifiers cannot override numbers: growth language attached to a reiterated number does NOT disqualify the plateau (forbidden escape, 2026-07-31: 'guidance is AT baseline, not flat'). WORKED EXAMPLE (Aug-7 prints): Meta stable +1 (2026 $130-145B reiterated within ±5% of prior), Microsoft BEYOND plateau — cutting +2 (FY27 $175B vs $190B prior, -7.9%), Amazon accelerating -1 ($220B raise), Alphabet accelerating -1 (2027 guided above 2026) -> N=2, S=+1 -> Partially fired. ENUMERATION HARD RULE: where-we-stand MUST list all four companies every day with stance, points, and last print date — 'awaiting print' when silent, never omitted. OUTPUT CONTRACT: when evidence contains a NEW forward-guidance number, emit exactly one line per company in the form LEDGER_UPDATE: <Company> | <PERIOD> | <low>-<high> | <event_date YYYY-MM-DD, the CALL date not the coverage date> | <source> — the deterministic ledger computes stance, count, score, and status from these; your prose never sets status. Other rules unchanged: NOT CapEx cutting as a de-risk — dollars remain enormous, the SIGNAL is the growth-rate surprise reaching zero; contrarian-direction ('we are done building — thanks Nvidia, Micron, SK Hynix'), never good news; a company leaves the tally only by re-ACCELERATING >10% above its prior guidance on a subsequent print; deep hyperscaler cuts also feed Tier 4 context but this signal persists.

Scenario A and Scenario B from Part 8 Indicator 5. CONTRARIAN-DIRECTION HARD RULES (v3.42.0, from the Jul-29-2026 inversion): (1) This is a PEAK indicator — the fire condition IS the bearish event. A first miss with guidance maintained is EXACTLY the fire, no matter how large the absolute profits or YoY growth are. NAMED COUNTEREXAMPLE: on 2026-07-29 SK Hynix printed record profit (+557% YoY) that MISSED consensus with guidance maintained — the textbook Scenario B fire — and the signal was instead REVERTED to Not fired with the fire condition ('beat magnitude dropped materially') recited as the reversal reasoning. Record absolute results are IRRELEVANT; only beat magnitude vs consensus and guidance direction matter. (2) The reversal condition must be the OPPOSITE of the fire condition (beat re-widening to >=30% on a NEW quarterly print, or guidance cut converting this into the T4 family) — never a restatement of the fire condition itself. (3) Once fired on a dated print, the status PERSISTS until the next quarterly print: quiet news days are not reversal evidence.
